Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “古代的时候” Formula: 在 + historical time period Correct: “在古代，孟子和孟母……”
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家” Formula: Subject + 住在 + place; 靠近 + place + 的 + house/place Correct: “孟子和孟母住在靠近墓地的房子里。”
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了” Formula: Subject + 才 + age + 就 + verb; habitual action + 每天 + verb (no 了); 祭拜 + object Correct: “孟子才五岁，就每天在墓地祭拜祖先。” “才五岁就……” is used very well here: it emphasizes that he was very young when he began doing this.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到” Formula: 从早到晚 + 都 + verb, but use 一直 when emphasizing continuous effort; 找不到 + object Correct: “孟母从早到晚一直找工作，可是找不到工作。” You can omit the second “工作” in more natural writing: “可是一直找不到。”
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “害得孟母没有钱” Formula: Result/cause + 害得 + person + result complement Correct: “结果孟母没钱了。” “害得” is grammatically possible, but it usually suggests that another person or event caused harm. Here, “结果” is more natural.
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “他们搬了到别一个城市找工作” Formula: 搬到 + place + (去) + verb; 另一个 + noun Correct: “他们搬到另一个城市去找工作。”

items.reason: “古代的时候” is redundant under the teacher's rule, and “在古代” fixes it, but the displayed correction trails off mid-sentence.
“住了在” has incorrect particle placement, and “靠墓地的家” is improved to a clear location expression.
“孩子” is unclear on first reference and sentence-final “了” does not fit this habitual daily action.
“从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到” is already grammatical, and the omitted object is recoverable from “找工作.”
“找不到工作” can cause the harmful result “害得孟母没有钱,” so the original 害得 structure is valid.
It correctly changes “别一个” to “另一个,” but it removes the needed completed-event “了” in this past narrative.
